messages.subject: Pmtpc
parts:
Hi, Chris,
In the paper (Drakesmith et al.,2015; Watson et al., 2019 ) that introduced MTPC, the authors calculated not only Amtpc and Acrit  but also Pmtpc.
I can not find  any information about Pmtpc in braingraph userguide, could you please show me how to calculate Pmtpc or where to find it ?
Thanks!

Li

messages.author: dadcb4fd6a01f8d1
messages.subject: Re: [brainGraph-help] Pmtpc
parts:
They only use Pmtpc "generically". That is, the only times I see it used in the paper is to state that a result is "< 0.05"; otherwise they just list "n.s." (not significant). This is because there are no P-values calculated for MTPC.

Chris
